test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

To keep away from
solution: The correct answer is '**Avoid**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Avoid**'. • **Avoid**: to keep away from somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति, वस्‍तु या स्थिति से बच कर रहना) • *Example: I leave home at 7 o’clock in order to **avoid** the rush hour.* **Correct Answer:__** *Avoid.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Devote**: to give a lot of time, energy, etc. to somebody/something. (किसी काम में बहुत-सा समय और शक्ति लगाना) • **Confront**: to think about, or to make somebody think about, something that is difficult or unpleasant. (किसी मुसीबत का या अप्रिय स्थिति का सामना करना या सामना करवाना; के आमने-सामने होना, मुक़ाबला करना) • **Fight**: to use physical strength, guns, weapons, etc. against somebody/something. (शारीरिक शक्ति, हथियारों आदि से किसी के विरुद्घ लड़ना) 35:Teb9, The correct answer is '**would know**'.
